items.title: Legal group files complaint in Italy against Israeli man for alleged Gaza war crimes
items.description: Hind Rajab Foundation, which has filed dozens of complaints against IDF soldiers abroad, claims visiting combat engineer's posts show 'public endorsement' of demolition operations The post Legal group files complaint in Italy against Israeli man for alleged Gaza war crimes appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: Ukraine Is Winning Its War On Russian Oil Refineries. On The Front Line, It's A Bloody Slugfest.
items.description: Ukraine’s drone campaign on Russian gasoline refineries is wreaking havoc, leading to nationwide shortages, fraying tempers, and mounting headaches for the Kremlin. On the battlefield, however, Ukraine’s troops face a grim fight. Look at what’s happening in Kostyantynivka.

items.title: Iran begins dayslong funeral for the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
items.description: Iran began a dayslong funeral Saturday for the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, months after an airstrike killed him at the start of the war. He was 86.

items.title: More than 400 dead in DR Congo's Ebola outbreak
items.description: In tonight's edition, Ebola is spreading beyond its original hotspot in the DRC as a new case has been detected nearly 600 kilometers away. And another human rights catastrophe is unfolding in Sudan around the besieged city of al-Obeid, the UN says.

items.title: How the Russian army lost its military advantage against Ukraine
items.description: Russia is becoming bogged down in the ground war and falling further behind technologically, while its human and oil resources dwindle. The Ukrainian army, supported by an innovative defense industry, has nevertheless been unable to switch to an offensive posture in ground combat.

items.title: 5 Killed in Ukrainian Strike on Market in Occupied Zaporizhzhia, Pro-Kremlin Official Says
items.description: Another 18 people were said to have been wounded in the afternoon attack on an open-air market in the city of Tokmak.

items.title: AI drones made in Germany see duty on Ukraine's front line
items.description: The German defense company Helsing is supplying combat drones to Ukraine and will soon provide them to the German army. How effective are they on the front line? DW joined a Ukrainian combat mission to find out.

items.title: Watch: BBC at site of deadly Russian attack on Kyiv flats
items.description: Sarah Rainsford reports from the completely destroyed nine-storey block of flats in Ukraine's capital.

items.title: From ‘greatest friend’ to ‘loser’: US-Iran deal sours many Israelis on Trump
items.description: Israeli attitudes toward U.S. President Donald Trump, once seen as the nation’s savior, have shifted dramatically. The initial U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal is already seen as a blow to Israel’s strategy and standing, and the backlash on the Israeli right has been harsh.

items.title: Zelensky Warns of Massive Russian Overnight Strike on Ukraine
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukrainian intelligence has identified signs of another massive Russian strike expected overnight, urging citizens to take shelter and heed air raid warnings. items.title: World News in Brief: Risk of atrocities in Sudan, UN programme prevents climate displacement, more civilians killed in Ukraine
items.description: Drone attacks by advancing rebel fighters who are besieging El Obeid, Sudan, continue to result in civilian casualties, putting around half a million civilians at grave risk of large-scale atrocities.
